missions.title: Prompt-injection robustness study
missions.description: LangGraph agent (Qwen via Groq) answering remote-sensing questions over Sentinel-2 NDVI, Sentinel-1 water extent and ERA5 rainfall for 6 Indian regions. 20 tasks, 5 injection styles (incl. Hindi), 2 defenses, 660 runs.
missions.result: 0 of 600 attacked runs led to a harmful action. Task success 96.5-100%.
